The letter {{AurB|h}} was the eighth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "herf", and had the value of /H/.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

The [[BTS-A2 Long-Range Strike Fighter/Bomber|H-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] resembled the letter {{AurB|h}}:
